reviews.text: I got two Border Collie puppies, Rocco and Polo, from Delta Agility Club. With the help of María and Raúl, we made the best decision. They guided us through every step and helped us choose the perfect puppies for my brother and me. I definitely had an experience like no other, the best service, and I can honestly say I'm the happiest person with my two dogs. Besides that, we had a training session with Raúl as soon as the puppies arrived, which made a huge difference and was a fantastic, educational experience. As for follow-up, I couldn't be more grateful to María. Even though the puppies have been with me for months, she's always checking in. She answers my questions, helps me, and advises me on anything that happens with them. I can definitely say it's the best place, with the best service and the most beautiful puppies!

We are so happy with our puppy, a healthy and very happy little girl. There was just a slight misunderstanding in the communication, which caused her to arrive two weeks later than agreed. Once she arrived, she came with a complete and up-to-date vaccination record and had been dewormed.
The communication between the breeder and the client was a bit informal in that videos weren't sent unless requested, and there was little follow-up on the shipment, but in the end, everything turned out as expected, and we are very happy with our newest member of the family.
Great place, I bought a dog from them and he's very beautiful and in perfect health. They are very friendly and provide excellent customer service.
